tariffs_metered_xor_fixed_check.name: tariffs_metered_xor_fixed_check
tariffs_metered_xor_fixed_check.value: ("tariffs"."rate_t1" IS NOT NULL AND "tariffs"."fixed_amount" IS NULL) OR ("tariffs"."fixed_amount" IS NOT NULL AND "tariffs"."rate_t1" IS NULL)

tariffs_rates_positive_check.name: tariffs_rates_positive_check
tariffs_rates_positive_check.value: ("tariffs"."rate_t1" IS NULL OR "tariffs"."rate_t1" > 0) AND ("tariffs"."rate_t2" IS NULL OR "tariffs"."rate_t2" > 0) AND ("tariffs"."rate_t3" IS NULL OR "tariffs"."rate_t3" > 0)

meters_removed_at_check.name: meters_removed_at_check
meters_removed_at_check.value: "meters"."removed_at" IS NULL OR "meters"."installed_at" IS NULL OR "meters"."removed_at" > "meters"."installed_at"

reminders_anchor_value_range_check.name: reminders_anchor_value_range_check
reminders_anchor_value_range_check.value: ("reminders"."anchor_type" = 'day_of_month' AND "reminders"."anchor_value" BETWEEN 1 AND 31) OR ("reminders"."anchor_type" = 'days_before_end' AND "reminders"."anchor_value" BETWEEN 0 AND 27)
